description: A RESEARCH RUN: send a question to The Librarian's workers. The library's own runner plans sub-questions (yours, if you pass them), researches each in parallel with web search + fetch noting every fact with its source, has a critic decide on a second round, and writes the investigation in sections; the result enters the library as a draft investigation attributed to you and the review crew extracts findings from it. Returns a job_id to poll with library_job. Write access. Takes minutes to hours ? do not wait inline.

collections.description: Optional: names of the person's collections (folders shelved with `researchzosho add <dir>`) to search.

max_minutes.description: Optional ceiling: the most wall-clock minutes the run may take ('two hours tops' = 120). The workers stop early enough for the write-up to fit. Absent or 0 = no ceiling.

max_turns.description: Optional ceiling: the most model turns the WHOLE run may spend (workers, critic, synthesis and cite-check together). Absent or 0 = no ceiling, the run goes until the work is done.

mode.description: broad (survey the landscape, default) | depth (deep-read a narrow question).

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

question.description: The research question, as you would put it to a librarian.

quick.description: Look it up now: the front of the line and short ceilings (12 turns, 6 minutes) unless the ask names its own.

sources.description: both (the shelves first, then the web ? default) | shelves (the person's own corpus only, no web) | web.

sub_questions.description: Optional plan: up to 8 self-contained sub-questions, each researched by its own worker instead of a decompose step.

name: library_research
